title: Command Looper
description: This is an Command Looper Plugin which can loop commands and stops all the loops by 1 command
body:
🔁 LoopCommand Plugin (Paper 1.21.4)

⚙️ Take full control of your Minecraft server with this powerful automation plugin! The LoopCommand Plugin allows players to automatically repeat any command at a custom interval — no need to type the same command again and again. Whether you’re a server admin testing features, a builder spawning mobs, or a player running fun commands, this plugin saves time and effort!

💬 Commands & Features:

🔄 /loopcommand <command> <delay> — Start looping any command you choose! Set your own delay in seconds to control how often the command runs. Great for automated testing, effects, or repeated actions.

🛑 /stoploops — Instantly stop all your running command loops. Keeps your server clean and prevents spam or overloads.

✨ Why use LoopCommand?
✅ Easy to use — no configuration needed.
✅ Works with any player command.
✅ Lightweight and optimized for Paper 1.21.4.
✅ Perfect for automation, testing, or creative gameplay.

🚀 Example Usage:
/loopcommand say Hello World 5 → Sends “Hello World” every 5 seconds!
/stoploops → Stops the loop instantly.

💡 Make your server smarter, faster, and more dynamic with LoopCommand!
